integrity: Proof by an explicitly defined binary-addition carry automaton with 192 possible states; reverse final-state reachability and exhaustive closure of 195 determinized reachable states provide a finite certificate of the infinite classification. Independent digit-sum witnesses and finite-prefix checks accompany but do not replace this proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies length-four fixed-difference arithmetic factors of binary Thue–Morse only. It does not handle longer blocks or minimal witness positions. A related 2003 foundational source was not available in full text, although its reported all-differences result is logically weaker.
title: Exact four-term arithmetic factor spectrum of the Thue–Morse word
